shell_commands:
git -C /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/d1992393a719/workspace/target commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(orchestrator): move beforeSession inside try block to call onError and afterSession on throw

beforeSession was awaited before the try block opened, so a throw from it
escaped before the catch and finally blocks. This meant onError and afterSession
never ran when beforeSession failed. Moving the call inside the try ensures
both hooks run and the error reaches the caller as a rejection.
EOF
)"

git -C /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/d1992393a719/workspace/target commit --amend --no-edit --message="$(git -C /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/d1992393a719/workspace/target log -1 --format=%B)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
git -C /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/d1992393a719/workspace/target fetch origin main && git -C /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/d1992393a719/workspace/target merge origin/main

git -C /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/d1992393a719/workspace/target add .lore/dod.md && git -C /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/d1992393a719/workspace/target commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'

)"
